sources.title: BBMP Citizen Services — Trade License
sources.notes: The public Trade License section exposes separate links for how to get a new or renewal licence, public new registration, public renewal, MOH contact/address details, and the FAQ. The page is a directory; it does not establish a current case result or current GBA target.

sources.title: Online New Trade License Registration — public payment guide
sources.notes: Direct public PDF. It describes mandatory fields, Next, owner-consent/lease and electricity-bill uploads, Send OTP/enter OTP, years selection and payment. No field, OTP, upload or payment was used.

sources.title: FAQ — Trade License
sources.notes: Direct public FAQ, with legacy/date caveat. It states 1–5-year selection, owner-consent/lease and electricity bill, optional OC, JPG/PDF and maximum 1 MB, no part-payment, and receipt/status/download features. Treat current implementation as unverified.

sources.title: Annexure G — Procedure for Applying for New Trade Licence
sources.notes: Direct official procedure PDF. It lists owner consent and latest property-tax receipt, Zone A neighbour consent, layout plan, licence/power demand drafts, rejection with endorsement when requirements are missing, and inspection scheduling within a maximum of 3 working days. The document is dated/legacy and is not proof of the current GBA implementation.

sources.title: Annexure F — Application for Trade New Licence
sources.notes: Direct official application form. It exposes Schedule X classification, health-officer jurisdiction, zonal classification, document checks, separate licence/power drafts, refusal-refund wording, and suspension/cancellation caveats. It is dated/legacy. No form was completed.

sources.title: Form B — Format of Owner’s Consent
sources.notes: Direct official owner-consent form. It requests the property number/address, latest property-tax receipt or other title document, proposed trade and zone, and records that the Corporation may issue, suspend, withdraw or cancel a licence. No personal data was entered.

sources.title: Online Trade License System (OTLS) — workflow description
sources.publisher: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike IT Department
sources.notes: Direct official IT description, published 2019 and therefore dated. It describes temporary application/payment challan, online/offline payment, inspection/document verification, staged MoH/DHO/HO review, final approval and status/license output.

sources.title: Trade License Contact — zonal Health Officer and technical contacts
sources.notes: Direct public contact page. It gives zone-wise Health Officer contacts, hours, Sahaaya 2.0 and a BBMP IT technical contact. The page is legacy/dated; use as a recovery lead, not as proof that every listed contact remains current.

sources.title: BBMP Trade License public portal landing page
sources.notes: Direct public portal landing page observed without login. It displays working hours, a public query email/phone, and a note that JC login is deactivated as per CHO approval. The page is legacy-looking; no login or authenticated operation was attempted.

sources.title: Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act, 1976
sources.notes: Official India Code Act record. Section 353 is the statutory licence basis for Schedule X purposes; the Act record does not determine a supplied trade’s current GBA category, fee, ward or exemption.

claims.text: The BBMP public citizen-service directory exposes separate Trade License links for new/renewal instructions, public new registration, public renewal, MOH contacts and the trade-licence FAQ.
claims.notes: This is a public directory lead; it does not prove the current city-corporation target, category eligibility or a case result.

claims.text: The public new-registration guide sequences mandatory fields, Next, owner-consent/lease and electricity-bill uploads, OTP send/entry, years selection and payment.
claims.notes: Published sequence only; no OTP, upload, payment or submission was performed.

claims.text: The public FAQ lists owner-consent/lease, electricity bill and optional occupancy certificate for a new trade, accepts JPG/PDF with a stated maximum 1 MB file size, and allows 1–5 years for new and renewal applications.
claims.notes: The page is legacy/dated; current category-specific requirements and upload validation remain unknown.

claims.text: The public FAQ says part-payment is not allowed and lists receipt reprint, online-payment acknowledgement, renewal-certificate download and application-status features.
claims.notes: The FAQ does not establish current gateway behavior, fee amount, receipt generation or status result for a particular case.

claims.text: The official new-licence form asks for the proposed trade, Schedule X part and trade classification, jurisdiction of the Health Officer, zonal classification and licence fee details.
claims.notes: The form is an official public artefact but dated; it does not decide a supplied trade’s current classification or fee.

claims.text: The official procedure lists owner consent with the latest property-tax receipt, neighbour consent for a Zone A trade, a layout plan subject to its stated size/trade exception, and licence/power demand drafts as new-licence filing requirements.
claims.notes: These are dated public document leads; confirm the current GBA corporation checklist before treating them as requirements.

claims.text: The official new-licence procedure says that if the filing lacks the requirements listed at serial numbers 4–8, the application will be rejected and an endorsement will be issued.
claims.notes: The document states rejection/endorsement but does not publish a current GBA resubmission or appeal mechanism.

claims.text: The official procedure says an authorised officer sets the inspection date on the filing date and the maximum time set for inspection is within 3 working days, using a compliance checklist.
claims.notes: This is a dated procedure statement, not a current GBA service-level promise; no inspection was requested or observed.

claims.text: The official application form says that if the licence is refused, the licence and power fees paid will be refunded, and warns that a licence does not regularise unauthorised construction or building-bye-law violations and may be suspended or cancelled for violations or defective information.
claims.notes: The form is dated and does not establish current refund processing, review rights or current GBA enforcement practice.

claims.text: The official OTLS description says a new case receives a temporary application number/payment challan, may use online or offline payment, and proceeds through site inspection/document verification and staged MoH, DHO and HO review before final approval.
claims.notes: The IT description is from 2019; it is a historical public workflow lead, not proof of current GBA routing or timing.

claims.text: The official OTLS description says an approved licence can be downloaded online or issued by a case worker/MoH and that application status can be checked online.
claims.notes: No status lookup, approval, download or issued licence was observed.

claims.text: The public Trade License contact page provides zone-wise Health Officer contacts, published office hours, a Sahaaya 2.0 lead and a BBMP IT technical-contact lead for fee or technical enquiries.
claims.notes: The page is legacy/dated; contact availability and current corporation ownership require confirmation. No contact was made.

claims.text: Section 353 of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act is the statutory starting point for a licence for purposes listed in Schedule X within city limits, subject to the Act’s provisos and amendments.
claims.notes: The Act supplies the legal basis, not a current category, fee, ward/MOH assignment or exemption decision for a supplied trade.

claims.text: No authenticated session, OTP, applicant identifier, document upload, payment, application submission, status lookup or licence download was performed in this official-source pass; those case states remain Unknown.
claims.notes: This is a research boundary, not evidence that the authenticated workflow succeeds or fails.

roadblocks.title: Missing document or filing requirement
roadblocks.symptom: The official procedure says a filing missing listed requirements is rejected and an endorsement is issued.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Missing owner consent/tax receipt, zone-specific consent, layout plan or fee draft under the dated procedure; current GBA checklist may differ.
roadblocks.recovery: Retain the endorsement, confirm the current corporation checklist and ask the responsible current health office how a corrected authorised filing should proceed; the public source does not publish resubmission mechanics.

roadblocks.title: Current GBA route versus legacy BBMP artefacts
roadblocks.symptom: Direct public service directories coexist with dated BBMP forms, FAQ, contact pages and OTLS descriptions.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Greater Bengaluru Authority/five-city-corporation transition and legacy trade-licence documentation.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm the current city corporation, ward/MOH and live target before relying on any dated checklist, fee, timing or recovery statement.
